import sys
p=sys.argv[1]; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("import { FrontendUrlBuilder } from '@common/url/frontend-url.builder'","import { FrontendUrlBuilder } from '@common/url/frontend-url.builder'\nimport { MilestoneDetectionListener } from '../notifications/listeners/milestone-detection.listener'",1)
s=s.replace("        JourneysService,\n","        JourneysService,\n        MilestoneDetectionListener,\n",1)
s=s.replace("describe('JourneysService'","describe('review milestone'",1)
s+='''
  it('one batch completing all steps emits JOURNEY_COMPLETED once', async () => {
    if (mongoUnavailable) return
    await moduleRef!.init()
    const j = await journeysRepository.create({
      propertyId: '000000000000000000000001', consumerOwnerId: '000000000000000000000002',
      creatorId: '000000000000000000000003', purpose: 'buy', status: 'active',
      sections: [{ key: 'main', title: { en: 'Main' }, order: 0 }],
      steps: ['a', 'b', 'c'].map((id) => ({ id, title: { en: id, es: id }, sectionKey: 'main',
        type: 'template', status: 'pending', precedents: [], resources: [], meta: {} })),
    } as unknown as Partial<Journey>)
    const completed = jest.fn()
    eventEmitter.on(EVENT_TYPES.JOURNEY_COMPLETED, completed)
    await journeysService.applyJourneyEdits(String(j._id), ['a', 'b', 'c'].map((stepId) => ({
      op: 'set_step_status' as const, stepId, status: 'completed' as const })))
    console.log('JOURNEY_COMPLETED emitted', completed.mock.calls.length, 'times')
    expect(completed).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
  })
})
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
